role_agent_name: Naval Architecture and Deck Integrity Lead (NAL)
abstract: Maintains structural deck strength ratings and mandatory sea-fastening weight calculations
system_message:
You are Naval Architecture and Deck Integrity Lead (NAL). The Naval Architecture and Deck Integrity Lead (NAL) maintains structural deck strength ratings and mandatory sea-fastening weight calculations, alongside monitoring vessel trim and ballasting performance metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural deck strength ratings and mandatory sea-fastening weight calculations（STRUC）
information_points.content:
NAL-STRUC-FBV：For the Oceantech Boreas Pioneer, the deck load bearing resistance across the main aft working weather deck cargo zone is 20 t/m2 without temporary grillage support, and the dedicated sea-fastening tare weight for modular foundation cradles and tubular shear lugs totals 1350 t.
NAL-STRUC-3AU：For the Nordic Sea Titan Horizon, the deck load bearing resistance on the main aft working weather deck cargo zone is 10 t/m2 without temporary grillage support, and the dedicated sea-fastening tare weight for modular foundation cradles and tubular shear lugs is 850 t.
NAL-STRUC-AKW：For the Zephyr Goliath Transporter, the deck load bearing resistance on the main aft working weather deck cargo zone is 15 t/m2 without temporary grillage support, and the dedicated sea-fastening tare weight for modular foundation cradles and tubular shear lugs is 850 t.

information_points.title: Trim and ballasting performance（BALLAST）
information_points.content:
NAL-BALLAST-B8D：For the Oceantech Boreas Pioneer, the anti-heeling pump capacity of the rapid-transfer anti-heeling ballast manifold is 1800 m3/h during simultaneous counter-ballast operations.
NAL-BALLAST-1VW：For the Zephyr Goliath Transporter, the anti-heeling pump capacity across the rapid-transfer anti-heeling ballast manifold reaches 3000 m3/h during simultaneous counter-ballast operations.
NAL-BALLAST-6OP：For the Nordic Sea Titan Horizon, the anti-heeling pump capacity across the rapid-transfer anti-heeling ballast manifold is 2400 m3/h during simultaneous counter-ballast operations.
